headlines.title: Trump’s focus on the press distracts Republicans from pocketbook issues
headlines.description: The media ban has dominated the news cycle for days, and rather than steer the conversation back to economic issues, has Trump amplified the furor.

headlines.title: Trumps says the U.S. will 'only encourage superintelligence' in AI
headlines.description: President Trump said in his remarks at the United Nations General Assembly that the U.S. would "only encourage superintelligence" when it comes to AI development, a notable declaration as warnings about the potential catastrophic consequences of the technology have spread.

headlines.title: Filmed in Captivity: Inside Russia’s Prison Propaganda Machine
headlines.description: Russian captors force Ukrainian prisoners of war to record propaganda videos designed to rally domestic support for the invasion and sow division within Ukraine. The videos often haunt former captives long after their release. NBC News’ Jane Lytvynenko travels to Ukraine to uncover how this propaganda influences local communities and the lives of returning soldiers.

headlines.title: ICE officer in Austin shooting was not wearing assigned body camera
headlines.description: The ICE officer who shot a Venezuelan man in Austin on Sunday, leaving a bullet lodged in his back, was issued a body camera but was not wearing it during the shooting, two officials with the Department of Homeland Security told NBC News.

headlines.title: Federal agents mistakenly target U.S. citizen during operation outside Chicago
headlines.description: An eyewitness describes the moments a U.S. citizen was mistakenly targeted by ICE agents in Evanston, Illinois. The man was injured after agents put him on the ground when he did not turn over identification.

headlines.title: ‘Looksmaxxing’ influencer Clavicular charged with rape of teen girl
headlines.description: “Looksmaxxing” influencer Clavicular has been charged in connection with the rape of a teenage girl at his family’s house in Cape Cod last May, according to a criminal complaint.

headlines.title: Hayden Panettiere died from accidental overdose of drugs, including fentanyl, coroner says
headlines.description: “Heroes” and “Nashville” star Hayden Panettiere’s death has been ruled an accident caused by the toxic effects of multiple drugs, including fentanyl, officials said Tuesday.

headlines.title: Simone Biles says three masked men burglarized her home and stole her car
headlines.description: Olympic gold medalist Simone Biles is down one luxury car and up one security dog after three masked men stole her Porsche GTS, she told her TikTok followers on Monday.

headlines.title: Trump touts peace settlements he has brokered in remarks to United Nations
headlines.description: President Trump said it had been a "great honor" to help broker multiple peace deals between nations during his address to the United Nations General Assembly. The president also touted the praise and thanks he had received from the leaders involved in the deals.

headlines.title: Kratom found at locations where two Ole Miss students were discovered dead
headlines.description: Two University of Mississippi students died this week and packaged kratom was found during the separate death investigations, law enforcement officials said Tuesday.

headlines.title: GOP defections from Trump start to pile up: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, we round up the latest examples of GOP candidates breaking with President Donald Trump. Plus, Natasha Korecki examines Republicans’ messaging strategy in Texas.

headlines.title: Trump bought and sold shares in Musk’s SpaceX in July, financial disclosure shows
headlines.description: Donald Trump bought up to $50,000 worth and sold up to $15,000 of shares in Elon Musk’s SpaceX in July,his latest stock buy involving a government contractor.
